title: MMDA: 2 bus drivers test positive for drugs ahead of Undas

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Two bus drivers tested positive in initial drug screenings conducted at transport terminals in Parañaque and Cubao as authorities stepped up safety inspections ahead of the Undas long weekend, the Metropolitan Manila Development Authority (MMDA) said Monday. At the Parañaque Integrated Terminal Exchange (PITX), one of the 32 drivers screened tested positive, while the other 31 tested negative. In a separate random testing conducted in three bus terminals in Cubao, another driver yielded a positive initial result among 86 drivers tested.
